scope: Primary-source overlap audit for candidate47; not exhaustive novelty verification

papers.title: Learning non-maximum suppression
papers.authors: Jan Hosang; Rodrigo Benenson; Bernt Schiele
papers.metadata_provenance: Paper Search exact-title search; local extracted PDF version header agrees
papers.reviewed: Abstract and4.1 loss: competing detections, one detection per object, earlier Hungarian matching-loss work and score-ordered benchmark-matching binary targets.
papers.overlap: Competition-aware detection scoring and matching-derived positive/negative labels are established. Relational scoring or adding a matching algorithm is not novel by itself.
papers.boundary: Candidate47 allocates PREDICTED cross-view observations to final hypotheses without GT, rather than using prediction-to-GT matching as a training label. The distinction alone is not a novelty or efficacy claim.

papers.title: FUSEye: Training-Light Fisheye Detection with Overlapping Views and Zero-Initialized Adapters
papers.authors: Wenya Su; Kai Luo; Di Wen; Ruiping Liu; Yufan Chen; Junwei Zheng; Kunyu Peng; Kailun Yang
papers.metadata_provenance: Paper Search exact-title search and existing local version header
papers.reviewed: AgreeFusion paragraph before/after Figure3: descending-score fixed-seed clusters use still-unassigned detections, IoU>=.5, distinct-view support, cluster scoring and final NMS.
papers.overlap: Disjoint greedy clusters already prevent a detection from being reused across clusters. Distinct-view support counting is explicit prior art. Candidate47 must beat ordinary exclusive greedy allocation, not just unrestricted support.
papers.boundary: Candidate47 retains all existing Soft-NMS hypotheses and allocates peer observations jointly instead of replacing them by disjoint cluster outputs. Its tiny conditional comparison is too sparse and does not establish an advantage.

papers.title: Learned Non-Maximum Suppression for 3D Object Detection
papers.authors: Timo Osterburg; Stefan Schuette; Torsten Bertram
papers.metadata_provenance: Paper Search exact search returned this related current paper; download_arxiv exact version
papers.reviewed: Abstract, IV-E supervision, V-A setup and matching ablation discussion: transformer/message-passing score refinement, metric-aware class matching and benchmark-specific center-distance thresholds.
papers.overlap: Learned detection-set score refinement and one-to-one foreground labels remain active but established, including current2026 work. It is not evidence that generic relation reasoning is an unoccupied research contribution.
papers.boundary: 3D nuScenes center-distance matching and class-agnostic second-stage supervision differ from the project's2D VisDrone IoU labels. No reported numerical gains from that paper are transferred to this project.

search_boundary: Paper Search query combining detection/box fusion with bipartite/one-to-one returned no matches; this limited query is not proof that no closer fusion-association prior exists.
result_boundary: Only7 tiny TP/FP pairs across6images; exclusive concordance.4286 below greedy.5714 and confidence.7143. Nine gates fail. No changes to stopped recipe and no training authorized.
